articleTitle: [Version 3.7 Featured Resonator/Weapon Convene: Phase Ⅰ]

articleContent:
The following base drop rates represent the mathematical chance of obtaining related items with a single convene. The average drop rates (including guaranteed drops) are derived from base drop rates and the guarantee mechanism, based on extensive sample/user testing. These rates may differ from the convene records of an individual player. Please spend responsibly.


Utterance of Marvels Convene Rules

- [Utterance of Marvels] is an event banner available for new players.

- Use [Lustrous Tide] to Convene. You are guaranteed to obtain at least one Resonator or Weapon of 4-star or higher rarity every 10 attempts.

- You can Convene up to 50 times in the [Utterance of Marvels] event banner. The event banner is available until you have obtained a 5-star Resonator, after which it will be closed.

- After the [Utterance of Marvels] event banner has closed, the [Beginner's Choice Convene] event banner will become available.

- [Utterance of Marvels] has separate Guarantee counts from other Convene event banners.


Rates

- The base 5-star Resonator drop rate is 0.8%. The average drop rate (including the Guarantee) is 2.4%. You are guaranteed to obtain at least one 5-star Resonator every 50 Convenes.

- The base 4-star Resonator or Weapon drop rate is 6.0%. The average drop rate (including the Guarantee) is 11.8%. You are guaranteed to obtain at least one Resonator or Weapon of 4-star or higher rarity every 10 Convenes.

- The base 3-star Weapon drop rate is 93.2%.


Extra Rewards

- On obtaining a 5-star Resonator for the first time, you will get 15 Afterglow Corals. On obtaining a 5-star Resonator that you already own for the 2nd – 7th time, you will get 1 Waveband of that Resonator and 15 Afterglow Corals. From the 8th time onward, you will get 40 Afterglow Corals.

- On obtaining a 4-star Resonator for the first time, you will get 3 Afterglow Corals. On obtaining a 4-star Resonator that you already own for the 2nd – 7th time, you will get 1 Waveband of that Resonator and 3 Afterglow Corals. From the 8th time onward, you will get 8 Afterglow Corals.

- Whenever you obtain a 4-star Weapon, you will get 3 Afterglow Corals.

- Whenever you obtain a 3-star Weapon, you will get 15 Oscillated Corals.

Notes

- You may redeem up to 2 limited stock Wavebands for each 5-star Resonator with Afterglow Corals.

- You may redeem various items with Oscillate Corals. Please visit the in-game Store page for current options and redemption limits, reset with each version update.

articleTitle: Convene Details

articleContent:
Dear Rovers,
To bring you exciting new content and a better gaming experience, we will soon be conducting the update maintenance for Version 3.7: Prism's Illusion, Heart's Illumination.
During the maintenance, you will be unable to log in to the game, so please plan your time accordingly. Additionally, due to the large size of the update, we recommend updating the game while connected to a Wi-Fi network. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
 
[Maintenance Time & Compensation Details]
✦Maintenance Time: 2026-09-30 04:00 - 2026-09-30 11:00 (UTC+8)
✦Maintenance Compensation: Astrite x300, Crystal Solvent x2
✦Compensation Eligibility: Create a character and unlock the Mail feature before 2026-09-30 04:00 (UTC+8). The compensation will remain claimable until the next version update.
※In the event that the maintenance is extended, the dev team will issue a follow-up notice and adjust the compensation accordingly.
 
[How to Update]
Once the maintenance for the version update begins, you can follow the following instructions to update your client.
✦PC: Close the game, restart the launcher, and then click on "Update."
✦Android: Launch the game and follow the instructions in the update pop-up window to complete the update.
✦iOS: Download/update the game in the App Store.
✦Mac: Download/update the game in the App Store.
✦PS5™: Open the home screen > Select Wuthering Waves > Press the OPTIONS button to Check for Update
✦XBOX Series X|S: Open the home screen > Select "My games & apps" > Go to "Manage Updates" to find Wuthering Waves > Update the game.
✦XBOX PC: Open the XBOX app > Select "My Library" > Select Wuthering Waves and open the Manage screen > Go to the Files tab and select Check for Update.
 
[Pre-download]
✦Pre-download Start Time: 2026-09-28 10:00 (UTC+8)
 
[Required Pre-download Storage Space]
PC: 46GB (Actual package size: 26GB)
Android/iOS: 20GB (Actual package size: 13GB)
※Pre-download may not be possible if your device does not have enough spare storage space. To ensure there is sufficient storage space for resource integration during the update maintenance, a certain amount of space must be reserved. If the reserved space is insufficient, the update maintenance will not be completed.
※After the update maintenance is complete, the extra space used for the resources merging process will be automatically freed up.
 
[How to Pre-download]
PC: When pre-download for the latest version becomes available, "New Version Pre-download" appears below the "Start" button on the launcher interface. Select this option to pre-download the resources.
Android/iOS: When pre-download for the latest version becomes available, press the "Pre-download" button, either on the title screen after a successful login or on the in-game Terminal page, and confirm to pre-download the resources.
※You can continue playing the game while the pre-downloading process is ongoing. The process can be paused at any time. Whether it is complete or not, the update maintenance will speed up to a certain degree when initiated.
※Please ensure that you have a stable network connection during the pre-downloading process.
 
[About the Schedule for the "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" Limited Test]
✦Test Participants and Test Schedule
PC (※Official Launcher): The test will become available in stages on PC following the Version 3.7 update.
iOS/Android Mobile: The test will become available on all iOS/Android mobile devices following the Version 3.7 update.
 
✦Notes✦
- We will soon (during Version 3.6) make a PC launcher update available to some of the Rovers who are granted access to the limited test. However, the "Tiered Client Resource Downloads" feature will only go live after the Version 3.7 update. During Version 3.6, being granted access to the limited test will not affect your current gaming experience.
- Following the Version 3.7 update, Rovers who have not been granted access to the limited test will have their resource package updated to the High-Definition (HD) version by default. Once you enter the test, you can adjust the resource tier based on your needs.
※The feature will also be gradually made available on PC platforms with non-official launchers after the test concludes. Please stay tuned for future announcements.
 
✦Additional Notes on the Limited Test and Version 3.7 Pre-Download
PC (※Official Launcher):
- For Rovers who are granted access to the limited test and update the official launcher during Version 3.6, Version 3.7 pre-download will be temporarily unavailable due to cross-version functionality differences. You may select and download a suitable resource tier after the Version 3.7 update.
- For Rovers who do not gain access to the limited test during Version 3.6, pre-download will remain available, and if they use the pre-download feature, the High-Definition (HD) resource tier will be downloaded by default. After gaining test access in Version 3.7, you can then choose a resource tier based on your needs.
 
iOS/Android Mobile:
- Once Version 3.7 pre-download becomes available, only a portion of the resources will be pre-downloaded on iOS and Android mobile devices. The remaining tiered resources will be downloaded separately after the Version 3.7 update, based on the package selected.

Dear Rovers,
To bring you exciting new content and a better gaming experience, we will soon be conducting the update maintenance for Version 3.6: Lamplight in Mirage, Sword's Resolve in Heart.
During the maintenance, you will be unable to log in to the game, so please plan your time accordingly. Additionally, due to the large size of the update, we recommend updating the game while connected to a Wi-Fi network. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

[Maintenance Time & Compensation Details]
✦Maintenance Time: 2026-08-20 04:00 - 2026-08-20 11:00 (UTC+8)
✦Maintenance Compensation: Astrite x300, Crystal Solvent x2
✦Compensation Eligibility: Create a character and unlock the Mail feature before 2026-08-20 04:00 (UTC+8). The compensation will remain claimable until the next version update.
※In the event that the maintenance is extended, the dev team will issue a follow-up notice and adjust the compensation accordingly.

[How to Update]
Once the maintenance for the version update begins, you can follow the following instructions to update your client.
✦PC: Close the game, restart the launcher, and then click on "Update."
✦Android: Launch the game and follow the instructions in the update pop-up window to complete the update.
✦iOS: Download/update the game in the App Store.
✦Mac: Download/update the game in the App Store.
✦PS5™: Open the home screen > Select Wuthering Waves > Press the OPTIONS button to Check for Update.
✦XBOX Series X|S: Open the home screen > Select "My games & apps" > Go to "Manage Updates" to Find Wuthering Waves > Update the game.
✦XBOX PC: Open the XBOX app > Select "My Library" > Select Wuthering Waves and open the "Manage" screen > Go to the "Files" tab and select Check for Update.

[Pre-download]
✦Pre-download Start Time: 2026-08-18 10:00 (UTC+8)

[Required Pre-download Storage Space]
✦PC: 50GB (actual package size: 22GB)
✦Android/iOS: 33GB (actual package size: 13GB)

※Pre-download may not be possible if your device does not have enough spare storage space. To ensure there is sufficient storage space for resources merging during the update maintenance, a certain amount of space must be reserved. If the reserved space is insufficient, the update maintenance will not be completed.
※After the update maintenance is complete, the extra space used for the resources merging process will be automatically freed up.

[How to Pre-download]
✦PC: When pre-download for the latest version becomes available, "New Version Pre-download" appears below the "Start" button on the launcher interface. Select this option to pre-download the resources.
✦Android/iOS: When pre-download for the latest version becomes available, press the "Pre-download" button, either on the title screen after a successful login or on the in-game Terminal page, and confirm to pre-download the resources.

※You can continue playing the game while the pre-downloading process is ongoing. The process can be paused at any time. Whether it is complete or not, the update maintenance will speed up to a certain degree when initiated.
※Please ensure that you have a stable network connection during the pre-downloading process.

articleContent:
Dear Rovers,
To bring you exciting new content and a better gaming experience, we will soon perform update maintenance for Version 3.5 "Blade of Past Resounds, Lingering Dream Hymns".
You will be temporarily unable to log into the game during the maintenance. Please plan your gaming time accordingly. As this update requires a large download, we recommend updating the game while connected to a Wi-Fi network. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your understanding.
 
[Maintenance Time & Compensation]
✦Maintenance Duration: 2026-07-10 04:00 - 2026-07-10 11:00 (UTC+8)
✦Maintenance Compensation: Astrite ×300, Crystal Solvent ×2
✦Compensation Eligibility: Create a character and unlock the Mail function before 2026-07-10 04:00 (UTC+8). The compensation mail is valid until the update maintenance for the next version begins.
※Maintenance duration may be extended depending on the actual progress. The development team will provide follow-up announcements and adjust compensation accordingly.
[How to Update]
Once the update maintenance begins, you can update your client using the following methods:
✦PC: Close the game, restart the launcher, and click Update.
✦Android: Launch the game and follow the in-game pop-up instructions to update.
✦iOS: Go to the App Store to download/update.
✦Mac: Go to the App Store to download/update.
✦PS5™: Go to the PS5 home screen, select Wuthering Waves, press the OPTIONS button, and select Check for Update.
 
[Pre-download Details]
✦Pre-download Start Time: 2026-07-08 10:00 (UTC+8)
 
[Pre-download Space Requirements]
✦PC: 76GB
✦Android: 29GB
✦iOS: 29GB
※Special Notice: Version 3.5 uses resource compression technology to update existing files in the client, so this pre-download is noticeably larger and requires more free storage than recent updates. This is a one-time adjustment; pre-download sizes are expected to return to normal starting with the next update. We apologize for the inconvenience this may cause Rovers in the meantime, and thank you for your continued support and understanding of Wuthering Waves.
 
※Please note that you will not be able to pre-download if you do not have enough reserved storage space.
※To ensure there is sufficient storage space for resource integration during the update maintenance, a certain amount of space must be reserved (PC: 76GB | Android/iOS: 13GB). Therefore, the actual download size for this pre-download is (PC: 52GB | Android/iOS: 16GB). After the update maintenance is complete, the extra space used for the resources merging process will be automatically freed up.
 
[How to Pre-download]
✦PC: When pre-download for the latest version becomes available, "New Version Pre-download" appears below the "Start" button on the launcher interface. Select this option to pre-download the resources.
✦Android/iOS: When pre-download for the latest version becomes available, press the "Pre-download" button, either on the title screen after a successful login or on the in-game Terminal page, and confirm to pre-download the resources.
 
※You can continue playing the game while the pre-downloading process is ongoing. The process can be paused at any time. Whether it is complete or not, the update maintenance will speed up to a certain degree when initiated.
※Please ensure that a stable network connection during the pre-downloading process.
 
--------------------------------------------------------------------
 
[Version 3.5 Content Preview]
[New Resonators]
5-Star Resonator: Yangyang: Xuanling (Havoc/Sword)
※Available from the [Voices on Azure Feathers] Featured Resonator Convene.
 
5-Star Resonator: Suisui (Glacio/Rectifier)
※Available from the [Blessings From Dewy Winds] Featured Resonator Convene.
 
New Rover Attribute: Rover (Electro)
※Complete Main Quest Chapter IV Act II "Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled" to unlock.
 
[New Weapons]
5-Star Weapon: Azure Oath (Sword)
※Available from the [Azure Oath] Featured Weapon Convene.
 
5-Star Weapon: Firstlight's Herald (Rectifier)
※Available from the [Firstlight's Herald] Featured Weapon Convene.
 
[New Region]
Mengzhou: Land of Xuanfang
This region includes the following areas: Xuanfang Hold, Eastern Xuan Peaks, Western Fang Peaks, and Southern Yuan Hills.
※Follow the guidance of Main Quest Chapter IV Act I "The Wind Before the Storm" to access this region.
 
[New Echoes]
Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis, Thousand-Puppet Pavilion, Fog Lionarch, Forbidden Bastion, Kernel Puppet: Joy, Kernel Puppet: Anger, Kernel Puppet: Worry, Kernel Puppet: Reflection, Kernel Puppet: Grief, Kernel Puppet: Fright, Fog Lionarch: Body, Fog Lionarch: Head, Smiter, Smolder, Porcelain Picket, Stone Picket, and Aureate Picket
 
Added Sonata Effects: Lamp of Nether Road (5pcs Set), Heart of Evil's Purge (5pcs Set), and Song of Feathered Trace (5pcs Set)
Added Tacet Fields: Western Fang Peaks Tacet Field and Eastern Xuan Peaks Tacet Field
Added Tacet Discord Nest: Southern Yuan Hills Tacet Discord Nest
 
[New Story]
Main Quest Chapter IV: Act I "The Wind Before the Storm"
Main Quest Chapter IV: Act II "Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled"
Main Quest Chapter IV: Segue "The Chant of Unseen Ties"
 
Exploration Quest: "Code Red: Corehazard"
Exploration Quest: "Faithful Heart Tested at Skyfall"
Exploration Quest: "Autopuppets in Fog Veiled Chambers"
 
[Feature Optimizations]
Added the Pioneer Experience feature, which integrates previous story fast track features and adds "Next Stop: Mengzhou"
Added the Resonator Voice Pack Customization feature
Added the Bioprint feature
Optimized the display effects of the Echo Gallery and Enemies, adding dynamic breathing animations
Optimized the Story Auto-Play feature
Optimized the Guidebook feature
 
[Other Optimizations]
Optimized the model appearance of Rover
Added resource compression technology on PC to reduce storage space usage
Added [XeSS 3] frame generation support on PC
Optimized the Resource Cleanup feature on mobile devices
 
[New Challenges]
Tactical Hologram: Sparring Challenge: Denia
The second cycle of Endstate Matrix is open: Version 3.5 - Version 3.8
 
[Other New Content]
[Expedition Motorbike Chassis] Cloud Ride
[Weapon Projection] Projection: Blade of a Thousand Arts
[Titles] "Virtual Beacon" and "Until We Meet Again"
[Sigils] "Space and Blake Bloom Medal," "Past the Endstate: Adversity Vanguard," and "Xuanfang Wonder"
[Avatars] Space and Blake Bloom
 
[New Store Arrivals]
[Outfits] Deluxe Outfit: Lynae - Peppermint and Deluxe Outfit: Chisa - Peach Parfait
[Accessories] Yangyang: Xuanling - Cloud Lark and Suisui - Upon Rosy Clouds
[Expedition Motorbike Model] Nightveil Piercer Premium Model
 
[Special Events]
[A Glimpse of Xuanfang] Area Exploration Event
[Shape of Yesterday] Photo Collection Event
[Lament Recon: Tacet Crisis] Combat Event
[Recaptured: Action Highlights] Combat Photography Event
[Lollo Campaign: New Journey] Featured Commission Event
[Virtual Crisis: Quadrant Trials] Crisis Trial Challenge Event
[Gifts of Aftertune] 7-Day Login Event
 
[H5 Web Events]
In Search of Lost Jade Web Event
 
※For more details regarding the new version update, system optimizations, and bug fixes, please stay tuned for the upcoming Version 3.5 Content Details.
 
--------------------------------------------------------------------
 
[Device Requirements]
To ensure a smooth installation and gaming experience, we recommend that Rovers refer to the following system requirements:
 
① Minimum Requirements
Android: OS version 7.0 or above, Snapdragon 835, MediaTek G71/72 or equivalent processor, 4 GB RAM or more
iOS: OS version 14 or above; iPhone 11 or later, iPad with A13 or equivalent processor, 4 GB RAM or more
Mac: macOS version 12.0 or above, M1 or later model, 16 GB RAM or more
PC: [OS] Windows 10 64-bit, [CPU] Intel i5 (9th Gen)/Ryzen 2700, [Graphics] GTX 1060/RX 570/Intel Arc A380, [RAM] 16 GB or more
 
② Recommended Requirements
Android: OS version 7.0 or above, Snapdragon 8 Gen 1+/Gen 2/Gen 3 or equivalent MediaTek processor, 6 GB RAM or more
iOS: OS version 15 or above; iPhone 13 or later, iPad with A15 or equivalent processor, 6 GB RAM or more
Mac: macOS version 15.0 or above, M3 or later model, 16 GB RAM or more
PC: [OS] Windows 10 64-bit, [CPU] Intel i7 (9th Gen)/Ryzen 3700, [Graphics] RTX 2060/RX 5700XT/Intel Arc A750, [RAM] 16 GB or more
 
③ Storage Requirements
Android/iOS: 60 GB
Mac: 155 GB
PC: 115 GB (SSD recommended for installation)
PS5™: Please ensure you have sufficient storage space to complete the update.
 
④ Controller Support
Mobile devices support the following controllers:
Wireless connection: Xbox series, Xbox Elite series, DualShock®4, DualSense®, DualSense Edge™
Mac devices support the following controllers:
Wired/Wireless connection: Xbox series, Xbox Elite series, DualShock®4, DualSense®, DualSense Edge™
PC devices support the following controllers:
Wired/Wireless connection: Xbox series, Xbox Elite series, DualSense®, DualSense Edge™
Wired connection: DualShock®4
※When connecting other controllers that support multiple input modes to a PC, we recommend adjusting their settings to Xinput mode for the best experience.

articleContent:
Dear Rovers,
To bring you exciting new content and a better gaming experience, we will soon be conducting the update maintenance for Version 3.4: The Dream Not Dreamed.
During the maintenance, you will be unable to log in to the game, so please plan your time accordingly. Additionally, due to the large size of the update, we recommend updating the game while connected to a Wi-Fi network. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
 
[Maintenance Time & Compensation Details]
✦Maintenance Time: 2026-06-08 04:00 - 2026-06-08 11:00 (UTC+8)
✦Maintenance Compensation: Astrite x300, Crystal Solvent x2
✦Compensation Eligibility: Create a character and unlock the Mail feature before 2026-06-08 04:00 (UTC+8). The compensation will remain claimable until the next version update.
※In the event that the maintenance is extended, the dev team will issue a follow-up notice and adjust the compensation accordingly.
 
[How to Update]
Once the maintenance for the version update begins, you can follow the following instructions to update your client.
✦PC: Close the game, restart the launcher, and then click on "Update."
✦Android: Launch the game and follow the instructions in the update pop-up window to complete the update.
✦iOS: Download/update the game in the App Store.
✦Mac: Download/update the game in the App Store.
✦PS5™: Open the home screen > Select Wuthering Waves > Press the OPTIONS button to Check for Update.
 
[Pre-download]
✦Pre-download Start Time: 2026-06-06 10:00 (UTC+8)
 
[Required Pre-download Storage Space]
✦PC: 17 GB
✦Android: 20 GB
✦iOS: 21 GB
※Please note that pre-download may not be possible if your device does not have enough spare storage space.
※A certain amount of storage space is required for the resources merging process during the update maintenance (PC: 32 GB | Android/iOS: 13 GB). Therefore, the actual size of the pre-downloaded resources is 15 GB on PC, 8 GB on Android, and 8 GB on iOS, respectively. After the update maintenance is complete, the extra space used for the resources merging process will be automatically freed up.
 
[How to Pre-download]
✦PC: When pre-download for the latest version becomes available, "New Version Pre-download" appears below the "Start" button on the launcher interface. Select this option to pre-download the resources.
✦Android/iOS: When pre-download for the latest version becomes available, press the "Pre-download" button, either on the title screen after a successful login or on the in-game Terminal page, and confirm to pre-download the resources.
 
※You can continue playing the game while the pre-downloading process is ongoing. The process can be paused at any time. Whether it is complete or not, the update maintenance will speed up to a certain degree when initiated.
※Please ensure that you have a stable network connection during the pre-downloading process.
 
--------------------------------------------------------------------

articleContent:
Dear Rover,
To bring you exciting new content and a better gaming experience, we will soon be conducting the update maintenance for Version 3.3: Reverbs From the End of Galaxies.
During the maintenance, you will be unable to log in to the game, so please plan your time accordingly. Additionally, due to the large size of the update, we recommend updating the game while connected to a Wi-Fi network. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
 
[Maintenance Time & Compensation Details]
✦Maintenance Time: 2026-04-30 04:00 - 2026-04-30 11:00 (UTC+8)
✦Maintenance Compensation: Astrite x300, Crystal Solvent x2
✦Compensation Eligibility: Create a character and unlock the Mail feature before 2026-04-30 04:00 (UTC+8). The compensation will remain claimable until the next version update.
※In the event that the maintenance is extended, the dev team will issue a follow-up notice and adjust the compensation accordingly.
 
[How to Update]
Once the maintenance for the version update begins, you can follow the following instructions to update your client.
✦PC: Close the game, restart the launcher, and then click on "Update."
✦Android: Launch the game and follow the instructions in the update pop-up window to complete the update.
✦iOS: Download/update the game in the App Store.
✦Mac: Download/update the game in the App Store.
✦PS5™: Open the home screen > Select Wuthering Waves > Press the OPTIONS button to Check for Update
 
[Pre-download]
✦Pre-download Start Time: 2026-04-28 10:00 (UTC+8)
 
[Required Pre-download Storage]
✦PC: 42 GB
✦Android: 30 GB
✦iOS: 30 GB
※Please note that pre-download may not be possible if your device does not have enough spare storage space.
※A certain amount of storage space is required for the resources merging process during the update maintenance (PC: 13 GB | Android/iOS: 11 GB). Therefore, the actual size of the pre-downloaded resources is 29 GB on PC, 19 GB on Android, and 19 GB on iOS, respectively. After the update maintenance is complete, the extra space used for the resources merging process will be automatically freed up.
 
[How to Pre-download]
✦PC: When pre-download for the latest version becomes available, "New Version Pre-download" appears below the "Start" button on the launcher interface. Select this option to pre-download the resources.
✦Android/iOS: When pre-download for the latest version becomes available, press the "Pre-download" button, either on the title screen after a successful login or on the in-game Terminal page, and confirm to pre-download the resources.
 
※You can continue playing the game while the pre-downloading process is ongoing. The process can be paused at any time. Whether it is complete or not, the update maintenance will speed up to a certain degree when initiated.
※Please ensure that you have a stable network connection during the pre-downloading process.
 
--------------------------------------------------------------------
 
[Version 3.3 Preview]
[New Resonators]
5-Star Resonator: Hiyuki (Glacio/Sword)
※Obtainable through the [Thousand Futures Mirrored in Snow] Featured Resonator Convene.
 
5-Star Resonator: Denia (Fusion/Rectifier)
※Obtainable through the [False Promise for Tomorrow] Featured Resonator Convene.
 
[New Weapons]
5-Star Weapon: Frostburn (Sword)
※Obtainable through the [Frostburn] Featured Weapon Convene.
 
5-Star Weapon: Forged Dwarf Star (Rectifier)
※Obtainable through the [Forged Dwarf Star] Featured Weapon Convene.
 
[New Area]
Dimmr Plains
Area includes: Solisia Landing, Sealed Fissure, Silent Crag, Dimmr Deep
※Reach the location during Main Quest Chapter III Act V "Starlights from Yesterdays."
 
[Utility: Expedition Motorbike]
Added Aerial mode, allowing the motorbike to glide across distances.
Added the "Aerial Tactics" Expansion Module.
Adjusted the handling of Bounce Jump.
Refined Cinematic Mode, with more dynamic camera moves.
Enhanced the expedition motorbike's lighting effects.
 
[New Echoes]
Voidwing Moth and two new COST 4 Echoes
 
New Sonata Effects: Reel of Spliced Memories (5pcs), Wishes of Quiet Snowfall (5pcs)
New Tacet Field: Solisia Landing Tacet Field
 
[New Stories]
Main Quest Chapter III Segue: Wishes in the Bell
Main Quest Chapter III Act V: Starlights from Yesterdays
Main Quest Chapter III Segue: Beneath a Melting Night Sky
 
[Gameplay Optimizations]
Added an icon for viewing and switching a Resonator's "Resonance Mode" within some of the game interfaces.
Added Convene animations for some weapons in the "Absolute Pulsation" Weapon Convene
Optimized the UI of certain pages.
 
[Other Optimizations]
Introduced self-developed mobile frame generation, designed to enhance in-game performance of mid-range mobile devices.
Added the "Anisotropic Filtering" graphics option On PC.
Added the "DLAA" graphics option On PC.
 
Optimized the Resource Download Options and Resource Cleanup features on mobile.
- The Resource Cleanup feature will now allow you to remove certain map environment resources.
- reduced the size of the minimum resources (Basic Resources) on mobile.
 
[New Cosmetics]
New Outfit: Plush Dream (Mornye - Deluxe Outfit)
 
Added an Outfit Accessory system, allowing you to equip specific Resonators with accessories.
Accessories: Aemeath - Snowfluff Seal, Hiyuki - Stillmind, Denia - Denia's Doll
 
[Other New Content]
New "Tactical Hologram: Synchronization" Challenge: Sigillum
New Phantom Echoes: Phantom - Reactor Husk, Phantom - Reminiscence Kronaclaw
New Sigil: Irreplaceable Memories
New Avatars: Tidesong Once More, Chuluu!
New Titles: Supernova Launcher, Fantasy Weaver
Expedition Motorbike Liveries: Flowers For You, Radiate into the Depths
Motorbike Accessory: Hiyuki Cube
 
[Anniversary Events]
[Second Coming of Solaris: Collab Season]
[Star Bouncing] Anniversary Event
[Cubie Derby: Championship] Anniversary Event
[Lollo Express: Promise Delivered] Anniversary Featured Commission Event
[Gifts of Grand Celebration] Anniversary Limited-Time Login Event
[Bountiful Waves] Anniversary Points Exchange Event
 
[Anniversary Web Events]
[Into the Memory Program!] Web Event
[Back to Solaris] Web Event
 
[Collab Events]
Crossworld Sync: Pt. 1
Crossworld Sync: Pt. 2
 
[Special Events]
[Depths of Illusive Realm: Chromatic Fantasy]
[Dimmr Traces] Area Exploration Event
[Dimmr Travelogue] Photo Collection Event
[Aced! Combat Mastery Test!] Featured Combat Event
[Beyond the Waves: Roya Frostlands] Featured Exploration Event
[Gifts of Starlight] 7-Day Login Event
 
[New Permanent Event]
Into the Land of Paradox
 
※For more details on the new content, optimizations, and bug fixes coming to the game in Version 3.3, please stay tuned for the upcoming release notes.

[Device Requirements]
To ensure a smooth experience, please refer to the following requirements:
 
①Minimum
Android: [System] Android 7.0 or later; [Processor] Snapdragon 835, MediaTek G71/72 or processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 4 GB or more
iOS: [System] iOS 14 or later; [Model] iPhone 11 or newer, iPad with A13 Bionic or processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 4 GB or more
Mac: [System] macOS 12.0 or later; [Model] m1 or newer; [RAM] 16 GB or more

②Recommended
Android: [System] Android 7.0 or later; [Processor] Snapdragon 8 Gen1+/Gen2/Gen3 or MediaTek processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 6 GB or more
iOS: [System] iOS 15 or later; [Model] iPhone 13 or newer, iPad with A15 Bionic or processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 6 GB or more
Mac: [System] macOS 15.0 or later; [Model] m3 or newer; [RAM] 16 GB or more
PC: [System] Windows 10 64-bit; [CPU] Intel I7 (9th Gen)/Ryzen 3700, [GPU] Geforce 2060/RX5700XT/Intel ARC A750; [RAM] 16 GB or more
 
③Required Storage Space
Android/iOS: 45 GB
Mac: 130 GB
PC: 130 GB; it's recommended to install the game on an SSD.
PS5™: Please make sure your device has sufficient available storage to complete the update successfully.
 
④Controller Support
Wuthering Waves currently supports the following controllers on Mobile.
Wireless Controllers: Xbox series, Xbox Elite series, DualShock®4, DualSense®, DualSense Edge™

articleContent:
Dear Rovers,
To bring you exciting new content and a better gaming experience, we will soon be conducting the update maintenance for Version 3.0: We Who See the Stars.
During the maintenance, you will be unable to log in to the game, so please plan your time accordingly. Additionally, due to the large size of the update, we recommend updating the game while connected to a Wi-Fi network. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
 
[Maintenance Time & Compensation Details]
✦Maintenance Time: 2025-12-25 04:00 - 2025-12-25 11:00 (UTC+8)
✦Maintenance Compensation: Astrite x300, Crystal Solvent x2
✦Compensation Eligibility: Create a character and unlock the Mail feature before 2025-12-25 04:00 (UTC+8). The compensation will remain claimable until the next version update.
※In the event that the maintenance is extended, the dev team will issue a follow-up notice and adjust the compensation accordingly.
 
[How to Update]
Once the maintenance for the version update begins, you can follow the following instructions to update your client.
✦PC: Close the game, restart the launcher, and then click on "Update."
✦Android: Launch the game and follow the instructions in the update pop-up window to complete the update.
✦iOS: Download/update the game in the App Store.
✦Mac: Download/update the game in the App Store.
✦PS5™: Open the home screen > Select Wuthering Waves > Press the OPTIONS button to Check for Update.
 
[Pre-download]
✦Pre-download Start Time: 2025-12-23 10:00 (UTC+8)
 
[Pre-download Storage Requirements]
✦PC: 36 GB. To ensure smoother subsequent processes, such as decompressing, it is recommended that you have at least 50 GB of spare storage space on your PC.
✦Android/iOS: 18 GB. Approximately 58 GB of storage space is needed for the decompression process. This space will be used only temporarily and will be freed up once the maintenance is completed.
 
※Please note that pre-download may not be possible if your device does not have enough spare storage space.
 
[How to Pre-download]
✦PC: When pre-download for the latest version becomes available, "New Version Pre-download" appears below the "Start" button on the launcher interface. Select this option to pre-download the resources.
✦Android/iOS: When pre-download for the latest version becomes available, press the "Pre-download" button, either on the title screen after a successful login or on the in-game Terminal page, and confirm to pre-download the resources.
 
※You can continue playing the game while the pre-downloading process is ongoing on PC or mobile. The process can be paused at any time. Whether it is complete or not, the update maintenance will speed up to a certain degree when initiated.
※Please ensure that you have a stable network connection during the pre-downloading process.
 
--------------------------------------------------------------------
[Version 3.0 Preview]
[New Resonators]
5-Star Resonator: Lynae (Spectro/Pistols)
※Obtainable through the [Undefined Spectrum] Featured Resonator Convene.
 
5-Star Resonator: Mornye (Fusion/Broadblade)
※Obtainable through the [Distant May the Starlights Be] Featured Resonator Convene.
 
[New Weapons]
5-Star Weapon: Spectrum Blaster (Pistols)
※Obtainable through the [Spectrum Blaster] Featured Weapon Convene.
 
5-Star Weapon: Starfield Calibrator (Broadblade)
※Obtainable through the [Starfield Calibrator] Featured Weapon Convene.
 
Synth Armament Series (5-Star):
Laser Shearer (Sword), Radiance Cleaver (Broadblade), Phasic Homogenizer (Pistols), Pulsation Bracer (Gauntlets), Boson Astrolabe (Rectifier)
※The weapons in the Synth Armament series are obtainable through Standard Weapon Convene.
 
[New Area]
Lahai-Roi
Area includes: Starward Riseway, Fangspire Chasm, Bjartr Woods, Stagnant Run, Rebirth Uplands, Etching Plains, Startorch Academy, Mawburrow Desert, Giant's Gaze
※Reach the area during Main Quest Chapter III Prologue "When the Unknown Thrums."
 
[New Echoes]
Hyvatia, Reactor Husk, Twin Nova: Nebulous Cannon, Twin Nova: Collapsar Blade, Flora Reindeer, Mining Reindeer, Ironhoof, Spacetrek Explorer, Sabercat Reaver, Sabercat Prowler, Frostbite Coleoid, Windlash Coleoid, Flora Drone, Mining Drone, Geospider S4, Zip Zap, Tremor Warrior
 
New Sonata Effects: Pact of Neonlight Leap (5pcs Set), Halo of Starry Radiance (5pcs Set), Rite of Gilded Revelation (5pcs Set)
New Tacet Discord Nest: Tacet Discord Nest - Lahai-Roi
※It has two difficulty modes: normal and difficult. A set number of Tacet Discords are available daily. Defeat them to claim the corresponding Echoes without spending Waveplates.
 
[New Stories]
Main Quest Chapter III Prologue: When the Unknown Thrums
Main Quest Chapter III Act I: What Burns Beneath Frostlands
Main Quest Chapter III Act II: Ode to the Second Sunrise
 
Exploration Quest: Where Light Takes Shape
Exploration Quest: No. 1 Biker
Exploration Quest: Lost Melodies
 
[New Features]
New Combat Mechanic: Off-Tune
New Utility: Expedition Motorbike
New Terminal Messaging Feature: WavesLine
New Main Quest Fast Track Event: Next Stop - Lahai-Roi
Resource Download Options, Resource Cleanup on Mobile
 
[Gameplay Optimizations]
Upgraded the "Reprise of Tides" Returnee Event
Adjusted "Fantasies of the Thousand Gateways"
 
[Interface Optimizations]
Added a Startorch Academy-style interface for the Birthday System
Added dynamic visuals to the lineup interface
Improved display for the event interface
 
[Other Optimizations]
Raised the Data Bank's max level to 30; after upgrading the Data Bank, COST1 (Common) and COST3 (Elite) Echoes will also receive enhanced drop rate counts.
 
[Other New Content]
"Tactical Hologram: Synchronization" Challenge: Dreamless
New Phantom Echoes: Phantom: Twin Nova - Collapsar Blade, Phantom: Twin Nova - Nebulous Cannon, Phantom: Chop Chop
New Sigil: Voyager of the World
New Titles: Bathed in Pain, Calamity Ender
Expedition Motorbike Liveries: Carefree Rainbow, Student Abby!
 
[Special Events]
[Lahai-Roi Pioneers] Area Exploration Event
[Capturing Starlight] Photo Collection Event
[Beyond the Waves: Lahai-Roi] Featured Exploration Event
[Peaks of Prestige: Rekindled Duel] Echo Combat Event
[Signs of a Silent Star] Leisure Event
[Startorch Racing] Leisure Event
[Gifts of Freshers Week] 7-Day Login Event
 
[Collab Event]
Persona Sonic
 
[New Gameplay Features]
Doubled Pawns Matrix: Pilot (New High Difficulty Recurring Challenge)
Operation: Frontier Renewal (New Permanent Event)
 
※For more details on the new content, optimizations, and bug fixes coming to the game in Version 3.0, please stay tuned for the upcoming release notes.
 
--------------------------------------------------------------------
 
[Device Requirements]
To ensure a smooth experience, please refer to the following requirements:
 
①Minimum
Android: [System] Android 7.0 or later; [Processor] Snapdragon 835, MediaTek G71/72 or processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 4 GB or more
iOS: [System] iOS 14 or later; [Model] iPhone 11 or newer, iPad with A13 Bionic or processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 4 GB or more
Mac: [System] macOS 12.0 or later; [Model] m1 or newer; [RAM] 16 GB or more
PC: [System] Windows 10 64-bit; [CPU] Intel I5 (9th Gen)/Ryzen 2700; [GPU] Geforce 1060/RX570/Intel ARC A380, [RAM] 16 GB or more
 
②Recommended
Android: [System] Android 7.0 or later; [Processor] Snapdragon 8 Gen1+/Gen2/Gen3 or MediaTek processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 6 GB or more
iOS: [System] iOS 15 or later; [Model] iPhone 13 or newer, iPad with A15 Bionic or processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 6 GB or more
Mac: [System] macOS 15.0 or later; [Model] m3 or newer; [RAM] 16 GB or more
PC: [System] Windows 10 64-bit; [CPU] Intel I7 (9th Gen)/Ryzen 3700, [GPU] Geforce 2060/RX5700XT/Intel ARC A750; [RAM] 16 GB or more
 
③Required Storage Space
Android/iOS: 70 GB
Mac: 150 GB
PC: 150 GB; it's recommended to install the game on an SSD.
PS5™: Please make sure your device has sufficient available storage to complete the update successfully.
 
④Controller Support
Wuthering Waves currently supports the following controllers on Mobile.
Wireless Controllers: Xbox series, Xbox Elite series, DualShock®4, DualSense®, DualSense Edge™
Wuthering Waves currently supports the following controllers on Mac.
Wired/Wireless Controllers: Xbox series, Xbox Elite series, DualShock®4, DualSense®, DualSense Edge™
Wuthering Waves currently supports the following controllers on PC.
Wired/Wireless Controllers: Xbox series, Xbox Elite series, DualSense®、DualSense Edge™
Wired Controllers: DualShock®4
※When you connect any other controller that supports multiple input modes to a PC, it is recommended that you set the controller to XInput mode for the best experience.

articleContent:
Dear Rover,
To bring you exciting new content and a better gaming experience, we will soon be conducting the update maintenance for Version 2.8: To the City Set in Amber.
During the maintenance, you will be unable to log in to the game, so please plan your time accordingly. Additionally, due to the large size of the update, we recommend updating the game while connected to a Wi-Fi network. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
 
[Maintenance Time & Compensation Details]
✦Maintenance Time: 2025-11-20 04:00 - 2025-11-20 11:00 (UTC+8)
✦Maintenance Compensation: Astrite x300, Crystal Solvent x2
✦Compensation Eligibility: Create a character and unlock the Mail feature before 2025-11-20 04:00 (UTC+8). The compensation will remain claimable until the next version update.
※In the event that the maintenance is extended, the dev team will issue a follow-up notice and adjust the compensation accordingly.
 
[How to Update]
Once the maintenance for the version update begins, you can follow the following instructions to update your client.
✦PC: Close the game, restart the launcher, and then click on "Update."
✦Android: Launch the game and follow the instructions in the update pop-up window to complete the update.
✦iOS: Download/update the game in the App Store.
✦Mac: Download/update the game in the App Store.
✦PS5™: Open the home screen > Select Wuthering Waves > Press the OPTIONS button to Check for Update
 
[Pre-download]
✦Pre-download Start Time: 2025-11-18 10:00 (UTC+8)
 
[Pre-download Storage Requirements]
✦PC: 20 GB. To ensure smoother subsequent processes, such as decompressing, it is recommended that you have at least 30 GB of spare storage space on your PC.
 
※We will be updating some of the existing game resources in order to optimize the overall performance of Version 2.8. Consequently, the pre-download feature will only available on PC for Version 2.8. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience you may experience. Thank you for your support for Wuthering Waves.
※Please note that pre-download may not be possible if your device does not have enough spare storage space.
 
[How to Pre-download]
✦PC: When pre-download for the latest version becomes available, "New Version Pre-download" appears below the "Start" button on the launcher interface. Select this option to pre-download the resources.
 
※You can continue playing the game while the pre-downloading process is ongoing on the PC launcher. The process can be paused at any time. Whether it is complete or not, the update maintenance will speed up to a certain degree when initiated.
※Please ensure that you have a stable network connection during the pre-downloading process.
 
--------------------------------------------------------------------
 
[Version 2.8 Preview]
[New Resonators]
5-Star Resonator: Chisa (Havoc/Broadblade)
※Obtainable through the [Horizon of Dawnbreak] Featured Resonator Convene.
 
4-Star Resonator: Buling (Electro/Rectifier)
※Obtainable through the [Requiem Without End] and [Neptune's Lullaby] Featured Resonator Convene banners. After the event ends, starting from the next version, 4-Star Resonator Buling will be permanently available in Featured Resonator/Weapon Convene and Standard Resonator/Weapon Convene.
※4-Star Resonator Buling will be simultaneously made available in the Afterglow Coral Store and will be removed at the end of the next version.
 
[New Weapon]
5-Star Weapon: Kumokiri (Broadblade)
※Obtainable through the [Absolute Pulsation - Kumokiri] Featured Weapon Convene.
 
[New Location]
Chronorift Metropolis
※Reach the location during Main Quest Chapter II Act XII "Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands."
 
[New Echoes]
Nightmare: Roseshroom, Nightmare: Tick Tack, Nightmare: Dwarf Cassowary
 
New Sonata Effect: Thread of Severed Fate (3pcs Set)
New Nightmare Purification challenge: Honami City Nightmare Nest
※In Nightmare Purification, a set number of Nightmare Tacet Discords are available daily. Defeat them to claim the corresponding Echoes without spending Waveplates.
 
[New Stories]
[Main Quest] Chapter II Act XII "Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands"
[Main Quest] Chapter II Segue "Flowing Starlight in the Iris"
 
[New Features]
Added the "one-click absorption of all absorbable Echoes" feature
Added the "Auto Supplement" feature to the Upgrade function
Added the "Mute when Game is in the Background" option on PC
 
[Performance Optimizations]
- Optimized the performance of Ray Tracing
- Optimized the performance of visual assets
 
[Other New Content]
New "Tactical Hologram: Phantom Pain" challenge: The False Sovereign
New Outfit: Downtown Repose (Zani - Deluxe Outfit)
New Phantom Echo: Phantom - The False Sovereign
New Avatar: Post-Doomsday Coffee
New Title: Honami Doom Walker
※Partipate in the combat event "Stranger Things in Honami" to win Phantom: The False Sovereign (Phantom Echo), Post-Doomsday Coffee (Avatar), Honami Doom Walker (Title).
 
[Special Events]
[Stranger Things in Honami] Combat Event
[Whispers of the Waves] Photo Collection Event
[Tactical Simulacra: Off Tune] Featured Combat Event
[Lollo Campaign: Rising Anew] Featured Commission Event
[Search for It! Bits of Lahai-Roi] Showcase Event
[Gifts of Amber] 7-Day Login Event
 
※For more details on the new content, optimizations, and bug fixes coming to the game in Version 2.8, please stay tuned for the upcoming release notes.
 
--------------------------------------------------------------------
 
[Device Requirements]
To ensure a smooth experience, please refer to the following requirements:
 
①Minimum
Android: [System] Android 7.0 or later; [Processor] Snapdragon 835, MediaTek G71/72 or processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 4 GB or more
iOS: [System] iOS 14 or later; [Model] iPhone 11 or newer, iPad with A13 Bionic or processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 4 GB or more
Mac: [System] macOS 12.0 or later; [Model] m1 or newer; [RAM] 16 GB or more
PC: [System] Windows 10 64-bit; [CPU] Intel I5 (9th Gen)/Ryzen 2700; [GPU] Geforce 1060/RX570/Intel ARC A380, [RAM] 16 GB or more
 
②Recommended
Android: [System] Android 7.0 or later; [Processor] Snapdragon 8 Gen1+/Gen2/Gen3 or MediaTek processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 6 GB or more
iOS: [System] iOS 15 or later; [Model] iPhone 13 or newer, iPad with A15 Bionic or processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 6 GB or more
Mac: [System] macOS 15.0 or later; [Model] m3 or newer; [RAM] 16 GB or more
PC: [System] Windows 10 64-bit; [CPU] Intel I7 (9th Gen)/Ryzen 3700, [GPU] Geforce 2060/RX5700XT/Intel ARC A750; [RAM] 16 GB or more
 
③Required Storage Space
Android/iOS: 35 GB
Mac: 85 GB
PC: 85 GB; it's recommended to install the game on an SSD.
PS5™: Please make sure your device has sufficient available storage to complete the update successfully.
 
④Controller Support
Wuthering Waves currently supports the following controllers on Mobile.
Wireless Controllers: Xbox series, Xbox Elite series, DualShock®4, DualSense®, DualSense Edge™
Wuthering Waves currently supports the following controllers on Mac.
Wired/Wireless Controllers: Xbox series, Xbox Elite series, DualShock®4, DualSense®, DualSense Edge™
Wuthering Waves currently supports the following controllers on PC.
Wired/Wireless Controllers: Xbox series, Xbox Elite series, DualSense®、DualSense Edge™
Wired Controllers: DualShock®4
※When you connect any other controller that supports multiple input modes to a PC, it is recommended that you set the controller to XInput mode for the best experience.

articleContent:
Dear Rover,
To bring you exciting new content and a better gaming experience, we will soon be conducting the update maintenance for Version 2.3: Fiery Arpeggio of Summer Reunion.
During the maintenance, you will be unable to log in to the game, so please plan your time accordingly. Additionally, due to the large size of the update, we recommend updating the game while connected to a Wi-Fi network. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
 
[Maintenance Time & Compensation Details]
✦Maintenance Time: 2025-04-29 04:00 - 2025-04-29 11:00 (UTC+8)
✦Maintenance Compensation: Astrite x300, Crystal Solvent x2
✦Compensation Eligibility: Create a character and unlock the Mails feature before 2025-04-29 04:00 (UTC+8). The compensation can be claimed before the next version update.
※In the event that the maintenance is extended, the dev team will issue a follow-up notice and adjust the compensation accordingly.
 
[How to Update]
Once the maintenance for the version update begins, you can follow the following instructions to update your client.
✦PC: Close the game, restart the launcher, and then click on "Update."
✦Android: Launch the game and follow the instructions in the update pop-up window to complete the update.
✦iOS: Download/update the game in the App Store.
✦Mac: Download/update the game in the App Store.
✦PS5™: Open the home screen > Select Wuthering Waves > Press the OPTIONS button to Check for Update
 
[Added Pre-download on Mobile]
Starting with Version 2.3, Wuthering Waves supports pre-download both on mobile devices and through the PC launcher, available simultaneously.
✦Pre-download Start Time: 2025-04-27 10:00 (UTC+8)
 
[How to Pre-download]
✦PC Launcher: When pre-download for the latest version becomes available, "New Version Pre-download" appears below the "Start" button on the launcher interface. Select this option to pre-download the resources.
※PC Pre-download Size: 6 GB. To ensure the smoothness of subsequent processes, such as decompressing, it is recommended that you have at least 12 GB of spare storage space on your PC.
 
✦Mobile: When pre-download for the latest version becomes available, press the "Pre-download" button, either on the title screen after a successful login or on the in-game Terminal page, and confirm to pre-download the resources.
※Mobile Pre-download Size: 6GB. Approximately 20 GB of storage space is needed for the decompression process. This space will be used only temporarily and will be freed up once the update maintenance is complete.
 
※You can continue playing the game while the pre-downloading process is ongoing on your mobile device or the PC launcher. The process can be paused at any time. Whether it is complete or not, pre-downloading will speed up the game update process to a certain degree.
※Please ensure that you have a stable network connection during the pre-downloading process.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

✦New Resonators
5-Star Resonator: Zani (Spectro/Gauntlets)
※Obtainable through the [Between Light and Shadow] Featured Resonator Convene.

✦New Stories

Event Quest: Your Summer Will Never Wither
 
✦New Features
Echo Aspect
Data Modification
Birthday Blessing
Glossary
Mobile Pre-download
 
Upgraded [Reprise of Tides] Returnee Event
 
✦New Events & Gameplay Features

✦Other New Content

Anniversary Specials

※Participate in [Gifts of Grand Celebration] Anniversary Limited-Time Login Event to obtain.

Limited-Time Rewards from Past Events
Projection: Somnoire Anchor, Projection: Ocean's Gift, Phantom: Dreamless, Phantom: Inferno Rider, Phantom: Lorelei
※Participate in [Gilded Nightmarket] Anniversary Points Exchange Event to obtain.
 
※For more details on the new content, optimizations, and bug fixes coming to the game in Version 2.3, please stay tuned for the upcoming release notes.
 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
[Device Requirements]
To ensure a smooth experience, please refer to the following requirements:
 
①Minimum
Android: [System] Android 7.0 or later; [Processor] Snapdragon 835, MediaTek G71/72 or processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 4 GB or more
iOS: [System] iOS 14 or later; [Model] iPhone 11 or newer, iPad with A13 Bionic or processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 4 GB or more

Dear Rover,
To bring you exciting new content and a better gaming experience, we will soon be conducting the update maintenance for Version 2.1: Waves Sing, and the Cerulean Bird Calls.
During the maintenance, you will not be able to log in to the game. Please plan your time accordingly. Additionally, due to the large size of the update, we recommend updating the game while connected to a Wi-Fi network. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

[Maintenance Time & Compensation Details]
✦Maintenance Time: 2025-02-13 04:00 - 2025-02-13 11:00 (UTC+8)
✦Maintenance Compensation: Astrite x300, Crystal Solvent x2
✦Compensation Eligibility: Create a character and unlock the Mails feature before 2025-02-13 04:00 (UTC+8). The compensation can be claimed before the next version update.
※In the event that the maintenance is extended, the dev team will issue a follow-up notice and adjust the compensation accordingly.

[How to Update]
Once the maintenance for the version update begins, you can follow the following instructions to update your client.
✦PC: Close the game, restart the launcher, and then click on "Update."
✦Android: Launch the game then follow the instructions in the update pop-up window.
✦iOS: Update the game in the App Store.
✦PS5™: Open the home screen > Select Wuthering Waves > Press the OPTIONS button to Check for Update

[PC Pre-download]
✦PC Pre-download Start Time: 2025-02-11 09:30 (UTC+8)
※With the pre-download feature enabled, "New Version Pre-download" appears below the "Start" button on the Launcher interface. Select this option to pre-download the material for the latest version. You can continue playing the game while the pre-downloading process is ongoing. The process can be paused at any time. Whether it is complete or not, the update maintenance will speed up to a certain degree when initiated.

articleContent:
Dear Rovers,

To bring you exciting new content and a better gaming experience, we will soon be conducting the update maintenance for Version 2.0: All Silent Souls Can Sing.

During the maintenance, you will be unable to log in to the game, so please plan your time accordingly. Additionally, due to the large size of the update, we recommend updating the game while connected to a Wi-Fi network. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.




[Maintenance Time & Compensation Details]

✦Maintenance Time: 2025-01-02 04:00 - 2025-01-02 11:00 (UTC+8)

✦Maintenance Compensation: Astrite x300, Crystal Solvent x2

✦Compensation Eligibility: Create a character and unlock the Mails feature before 2025-01-02 04:00 (UTC+8). The compensation can be claimed before the next version update.

※In the event that the maintenance is extended, the dev team will issue a follow-up notice and adjust the compensation accordingly.




[How to Update]

Once the maintenance for the version update begins, you can follow the following instructions to update your client.

✦Android: Launch the game and follow the instructions in the update pop-up window to complete the update.

✦iOS: Update the game in the App Store.

✦PC: Close the game, restart the launcher, and then click on "Update."




[PC Pre-download]

✦PC Pre-download Start Time: 2024-12-31 09:30 (UTC+8)

※With the pre-download feature enabled, "New Version Pre-download" appears below the "Start" button on the Launcher interface. Select this option to pre-download the material for the latest version. You can continue playing the game while the pre-downloading process is ongoing. The process can be paused at any time. Whether it is complete or not, the update maintenance will speed up to a certain degree when initiated.

※The pre-download package is about 45 GB in size. To ensure smoother decompressing and installing processes, it is recommended you have at least 60 GB of spare storage space on your PC.




[Version 2.0 Preview]

✦New Region

Rinascita

Ragunna, in southern Rinascita, holds the closest bond with their Sentinel Imperator among the nation's many city-states. Most Ragunnesi worship the Sentinel, viewing Common Echoes as divine blessings. Ragunna is also home to the Order of the Deep, widely regarded as the Sentinel's earthly emissaries.

The Black Shores report that the Threnodian in Ragunna remains dormant. In recent years, however, even Sentinel Imperator has fallen silent, no longer speaking directly to the Ragunnesi...




✦New Resonators

5-Star Resonators: Carlotta, Roccia

※5-Star Resonator Carlotta can be obtained through the [When Silence Tolls] Featured Resonator Convene. 5-Star Resonator Roccia can be obtained through the [Stage in the Box] Featured Resonator Convene.




✦New Weapons

5-Star Weapons: The Last Dance, Tragicomedy

4-Star Weapon: Call of the Abyss

4-Star Weapon Series (Poetry and Paean): Meditations on Mercy, Fables of Wisdom, Romance in Farewell, Legend of Drunken Hero, Waltz in Masquerade




✦New Echoes

Hecate, Lorelei, Dragon of Dirge, Sentry Construct, Questless Knight, Diurnus Knight, Nocturnus Knight, Abyssal Gladius, Abyssal Mercator, Abyssal Patricius, Chop Chop, Vitreum Dancer, Cuddle Wuddle, Chop Chop: Leftless, Chop Chop: Rightless, Chop Chop: Headless, Fae Ignis, Nimbus Wraith, Hocus Pocus, Lottie Lost, Diggy Duggy, Frostscourge Stalker, Voltscourge Stalker, Galescourge Stalker, Chest Mimic, Nightmare: Feilian Beringal, Nightmare: Impermanence Heron, Nightmare: Thundering Mephis, Nightmare: Tempest Mephis, Nightmare: Crownless, Nightmare: Inferno Rider, Nightmare: Mourning Aix




✦New Events

[Rinascita] Regional Events: Tales of the Isles - Area Exploration Event, Traces of Tides - Photo Collection Event

[Although Colors Have No Form] Featured Co-op Combat Event

[Lollo Campaign: Comeback] Featured Commission Event

[John Wicktorio: No Debts for Old Men] Featured Combat Event

[Pincer Maneuver Warriors] Recurring Combat Event

[Celebration Aftertunes] Gratitude for Companionship

[Dances For Spring's Return] Companion Invitation Login Event




✦New Stories

Main Quest Chapter II: All Silent Souls Can Sing

As you looked into the repaired Tethys System for ways to solve Abby's bodily issues, you stumbled upon a Beacon you had set for yourself. Your past self pointed you in the direction of the distant land across the sea.

Time to set forth, Rover. Brave the storms and undercurrents to reach the grand celebration that awaits—and to honor the ancient pact you made long ago...




Main Quest: Chapter II Prologue - Through the Sea Thou Break

Main Quest: Chapter II Act I - The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes

Main Quest: Chapter II Act II - Veils Off in Sun or Shadow

Main Quest: Chapter II Act III - What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing

Carlotta's Companion Story: If On a Rainy Night a Family

Roccia's Companion Story: Starry is the Night




✦Other New Content

New Tactical Hologram Challenges: Tactical Hologram - Phantom Pain

New Gameplay: Amidst the Sea of Clouds

New Phantom Echoes: Phantom - Sentry Construct, Phantom - Questless Knight, Phantom - Vitreum Dancer

New Feature: Outfits (New Outfits: Exorcistic Adjuration, Peach Blossom)

※Participate in Glamour Couture to try out Jinhsi's Outfit "Peach Blossom."

※Participate in Dances For Spring's Return: Companion Invitation Login Event to claim Sanhua's Signature Outfit (Exorcistic Adjuration) for free.




※For more details on the new content, optimizations, and bug fixes coming to the game in Version 2.0: All Silent Souls Can Sing, please stay tuned for the upcoming release notes.




[Device Requirements]

To ensure a smooth experience, please refer to the following requirements:




①Minimum

Android: [System] Android 7.0 or later; [Processor] Snapdragon 835, MediaTek G71/72 or processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 4 GB or more

iOS: [System] iOS 14 or later; [Model] iPhone 11 or newer, iPad with A13 Bionic or processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 4 GB or more

PC: [System] Windows 10 64-bit; [CPU] Intel I5 (9th Gen)/Ryzen 2700; [GPU] Geforce 1060/RX570/Intel ARC A380, [RAM] 16 GB or more




②Recommended

Android: [System] Android 7.0 or later; [Processor] Snapdragon 8 Gen1+/Gen2/Gen3 or MediaTek processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 6 GB or more

iOS: [System] iOS 15 or later; [Model] iPhone 13 or newer, iPad with A15 Bionic or processors of better/equivalent performance; [RAM] 6 GB or more

PC: [System] Windows 10 64-bit; [CPU] Intel I7 (9th Gen)/Ryzen 3700, [GPU] Geforce 2060/RX5700XT/Intel ARC A750; [RAM] 16 GB or more




③Required Storage Space

Android/iOS: 25 GB

PC: 60 GB; it's recommended to install the game on an SSD.




④Controller Support

Wuthering Waves currently supports the following controllers on Mobile:

Wireless Controllers: Xbox series, Xbox Elite series, DualShock®4, DualSense®, DualSense Edge™

Wuthering Waves currently supports the following controllers on PC:

Wired/Wireless Controllers: Xbox series, Xbox Elite series, DualSense®, DualSense Edge™

Wired Controllers: DualShock®4

[Version 1.3 Preview]

✦New Region: The Black Shores

Tucked away in the tempestuous Stormy Sea lies an archipelago known for its lavish Tacetite deposits and as a refuge for the world's most talented individuals. With a mission to combat the destructive Lament, the Black Shores has fostered strong partnerships with nations across Solaris-3.

The archipelago cannot be accessed from any known lands. Only those recognized by the Black Shores or who have received an invitation and guidance can navigate their way to this hidden place.

✦New Resonators: 5-Star Resonator – Shorekeeper, 4-Star Resonator – Youhu

✦New Weapons: 5-Star Weapon – Stellar Symphony, 4-Star Weapon Series – Deep Sky Blazar

✦New Echo: Fallacy of No Return

✦New Events: Where Stars Slumber – An exploration event, Amidst the Stars – A Chrono Trace-collecting event, Infinite Battle Simulation– A limited-time, combat-themed event, Solaris Weather Forecast – A limited-time, Dataset-collecting Overdash challenge, Fairy Tale's Finale – A limited-time challenge in Co-op mode, Lollo Campaign: Rerun – A limited-time, task-based event

✦New Stories: Main Quest – To the Shore's End (Chapter I Act VIII), Companion Story – Small Wooly, Big Adventures (Encore), Side Quest – Cerulean Echoes Adrift in the Winds

✦Other New Content: Phantom Appearances – Phantom: Gulpuff, Phantom: Lumiscale Construct; New Challenge – Tactical Hologram: Inferno Rider; New Dishes: Honeysuckle Cake, Fisher's Chowder

※For more details on the new content, optimizations, and bug fixes coming to the game in Version 1.3: To the Shore's End, please stay tuned for the upcoming release notes.


[PC Launcher Update Notice]

To provide a better gaming experience for all Rovers, we released the 1.6.2 launcher update on 2024-09-20 (UTC+8), introducing the following new features:

1. Pre-download feature for the PC launcher

① With the pre-download feature enabled, New Version Pre-download appears below the Start button on the Launcher 1.6.2 interface. Select this option to pre-download the material for the latest version.

② You can pause the pre-downloading process at any time. Whether the process is complete or not, the update maintenance will speed up to a certain degree when initiated.

※ The pre-download material is approximately 30GB in size. Make sure that you have enough storage space on your PC.

2. Default use of DirectX 12 to launch the game (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20 Series and above, Intel graphics cards)

① With DirectX 12, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 40 Series graphics cards will support DLSS 3 super resolution and NVIDIA Reflex, while XeSS upscaling will be enabled for Intel graphics cards. This update will also improve compatibility across a wide range of GPUs, resolving issues such as black screens or visual distortions caused by certain hardware.

② After the update, shaders will need to be recompiled the first time you launch the game with DirectX 12. This process may cause some initial stuttering or frame rate drops, but performance will return to normal once it's complete.

※ If shader compilation causes extended stuttering or disrupts gameplay, you can exit the game and select Launch with DirectX 11 below the Start button, or contact customer service for assistance.
